title: EAOA League 2017
text: There were several SuffOC age-class winners in the 2017 EAOA league: congratulations to Roderick (M20), Will (M55), Chloe (W16), Bronwen (W20), Lizzie (W35) & Sarah (W50). The first league event of 2018 is the SOS one at Baddow Ridge on 28th January; complete results for 2017 can be seen on the EAOA website.
